description: Where one vault’s capital is exposed, as a graph: vault → market → collateral, loan asset and oracle. Every edge carries its size in dollars, its share of what the vault allocates, the vault’s share of the market, the LLTV where it secures, when it was read and where from. Cut from the vault’s due-diligence document, the same engine the report and vault_check use, so it says nothing the report does not. A node not fully read has `state: unknown` and says what was not read (an oracle’s feeds are never assessed here), and capital in no market read is its own node, never dropped. Free. It does not assess the collateral’s quality, the borrowers or the oracle, and it is not a block-level reconciliation.
name: vault_exposure_graph

edges.description: from, to, kind (supplies, secured-by, lends, priced-by, not-placed), usd, shareOfAllocated, shareOfMarket, lltv, readAt, source.

meta.description: How current this answer is and what it was read from: `freshness` and the ages behind it. Present on every answer from this server, whatever the tool.

nodes.description: id, kind (vault, market, collateral, loan-asset, oracle, unplaced), label, state (read or unknown), unread, address.

says.description: What the graph holds, in one sentence.

warnings.description: Anything the server wants a caller to know about THIS answer before acting on it. Empty is the normal case and is not a guarantee.

title: Where one vault is exposed
